lernapps.github.io.reason: One commit in the package's repo.
lernapps.github.io.message:
refactor: chrome/ is now site-frame/

## Intent

"Chrome" is UI jargon that people and agents in the organisation do not understand at once. The frame that every site shares should have a name that says what it is: the site frame.

## Key changes

- Folder site-frame/, files frame.js and frame.css (published as lernapps-frame.css), command lernapps-frame, export @lernapps/site/frame.
- lernapps-check, the class prefix la- and the shortcodes laHead, laHeader and laFooter stay.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same rename in lernapps.github.io (bd3ca7c), apps (a1b8882), docs (0774942), app-templates (9b3a492), .github (abf3760), tooling (befc855); apps (621864d) and docs (0193b4c) then pin the frame and the site actions to main.
